description: Figure 1 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating two metrics—average accuracy and average token count—for four methods (CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT) as summarized in the caption “Average Performance and Tokens of CoUT and Baselines for 4 LRMs over 4 Benchmarks.” The chart is split into two side-by-side groups: the left group is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and the right group is labeled “Token Count,” with the method categories shown via a legend beneath the plot. In the Accuracy group, the vertical value axis is labeled in percent and spans roughly from 70 to 100 with evenly spaced tick marks (about 5-point intervals), and the four bars are colored red (CoT), orange (CoD), light blue (CCoT), and green (CoUT), with values printed above each bar: CoT at 91.19, CoD at 80.89, CCoT at 88.50, and CoUT at 88.40. In the Token Count group, the vertical value axis spans from 0 to 800 with regularly spaced ticks (about 100-token intervals), and the same four color-coded bars appear with numeric labels above them: CoT at 676.85, CoD at 534.24, CCoT at 445.91, and CoUT at 354.46. The bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude; instead, they appear in a consistent left-to-right method order within each metric group (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT), and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and the value annotations above each bar.
